issues.reason: Propositional attitudes prescribes Experiencer for the holder of a verb of thought or speech taking a clausal complement (claim / say are listed non-factives), so Agent is the wrong role on the reporting event.

The placement half stands — the QuantifierPhrase companion must not be a conjunct of the rule's consequent, where it becomes content every instance derives — but "top-level statement" does not: a non-factive report asserts nothing of P, so the companion belongs as a sealed sibling of the Implication under Theme, which is where the repair puts it.

The observation is right that the sealed Implication carries no strength so the ~0.1 proportion reaches the KB only as the surface companion, but this is the reviewer's own registered gap (a sealed term has no truth-value slot) rather than a repairable defect, and no emitted atom is thereby false or ill-typed.

(MeasureAtLeast (sk_raise $x) risk 25 percent) says the raising event itself carries a risk of at least 25 percent, which the text does not state — the 25 percent is the size of the increase — so the atom is false and ill-typed in both its entity and scale slots.

gaps_confirmed: numeric proportional quantifier over a bare kind ("nearly one in 10 people") — the quantifier-word-to-strength table covers all/most/many/few/no and Fraction is scoped to "of the" partitives, so there is no mapping
a quantified generic sealed under a propositional attitude — a sealed term has no truth-value slot, so the quantity cannot ride the strength channel
"raise / increase X by N percent" — a differential change of measure on an event has no licensed encoding (MoreBy compares two entities on a scale)
new_gaps: where a QuantifierPhrase companion goes when the rule it annotates is sealed — the companion is specified as a top-level statement beside its rule, and nothing says whether it should project, stay sealed beside the rule, or be dropped
repair_summary: Changed the reporting event's holder role from Agent to Experiencer. Lifted the QuantifierPhrase companion out of the rule's consequent to a sealed sibling of the Implication, the Theme term becoming (And (Implication ...) (QuantifierPhrase ...)) — not top level, which would assert a generalization the non-factive report leaves unasserted. Removed (MeasureAtLeast (sk_raise $x) risk 25 percent), since no licensed encoding of "raise X by N percent" exists and a false atom is deleted rather than replaced.
notes: After repair the proportion survives only as the surface "nearly one in 10" word inside the seal; its strength channel remains unrepresentable, which is the registered gap. The rest of the sealed rule — have/Holder/Theme, the Can-marked raise with the mutation as Agent, and (Of (sk_risk $x) cancer) — is licensed as written.
